issue: Tier 1 Schleicher (1868) text: faithful to source, but its notation (akwāsas, a-vocalism, no laryngeals) clashes with the corpus.
kʷíd moy déh₃etes? is the 2/3du subjunctive addressed to a single man ('What will you give me?'); should be 2sg déh₃esi.
h₂égʰos is the neuter noun 'distress', used as predicate for 'bad' (pṓds h₂égʰos); stretched sense.
h₁éwkoh₂ 'learn' is in the full gloss.
misdʰóm wn̥tóm? uses the 2du/IMP.2du aorist for 'Did he win a prize?'; should be 3sg wént (the answer has ne wént). Also swóm ... ḱóymom 'his own village' for English 'my village' (minor).
fear: yéwgesos is GEN=ABL in the s-stem, h₁ésmōd ablative; fine.
dweh₂róybʰos (dat/abl pl) modifies h₂éǵrom (acc sg) 'to the far field'; should be acc sg m dweh₂róm.
déh₂nu is neuter in the lexicon, so h₁énod agrees.
spélom 'story' is a project reconstruction (coined flag); otherwise fine.
gʷmih₁tā́m is the 3du optative for 'may you come back' addressed to one sister; should be 2sg optative (gʷm̥yéh₁s).
Tier 1 Byrd text: a-colouring spellings h₂áwyes, h₂wl̥h₁náh₂; agʰnutór without h₂; unaccented h₁esti; English 'the sheep has' against plural h₂áwibʰyos.
dʰégʷʰh₂t full gloss includes 'pass by'; deywóǵenh₁ēs is a name 'of divine lineage', not 'race' = contest.
ǵómbʰos 'peg' is in the full gloss. Last turn 'Show me!' is a weak follow-up.
dwirótom 'two-wheeled' wagon: acceptable as a solid-wheeled cart, borderline for the period.
h₂éwh₂os 'maternal uncle' is in the full gloss.
snusós 'bride' is in the full gloss; h₂én 'there'.
